name: maximal_cliques
author: ab9fb3a3
description: Finds maximal cliques with pivoted Bron-Kerbosch: every pair is connected and no other node can extend the clique. Use to find fully connected groups and the largest such group. Supports nonempty undirected graphs, including disconnected graphs; ignores weights and self-loops. Returns the largest top_k cliques, sorted by size descending then lexicographic member IDs, with complete labelled membership and a registered graph_id for each. result_graph_id identifies the first/largest clique. Enumeration is exponential; prefer small graphs.

graph_id.description: ID of a graph registered in the provided store.

top_k.description: Maximum number of largest maximal cliques to return, each with full membership.
